summary.title: codeslinger.co.uk - Gameboy Emulation
summary.one_liner: A personal site section documenting how the author wrote a Game Boy emulator in C++, with source download and a list of reference documents.
takeaways: The author's C++ Game Boy emulator reaches about 95% compatibility but has no sound.
Source code is downloadable and compiles under Visual Studio (Windows) and Linux with Codeblocks.
The build has no GUI or memory dumping; the ROM filename must be changed in Gameboy.cpp and recompiled.
Key references are GB.pdf (all opcodes and Game Boy material) and Pan Docs (more accurate hardware info).
The author supplies no ROMs or links; the page states you must own the games you emulate.
summary.summary: This page is a section of codeslinger.co.uk about Game Boy emulation, written by the author who built their own emulator. It describes the emulator's state (about 95% compatibility, no sound), links to downloadable C++ source that builds on Windows and Linux, and notes that the code has no GUI. It lists two resources used to finish the project: GB.pdf, which covers opcodes and Game Boy material, and Pan Docs, which gives more accurate hardware details. The page is mainly an overview and index, with navigation to further pages and screenshots.
